@ S-1161 (2): the division of an at expression with m = 0 panics in a call of 0 frames
process 0 params n=6 m=0 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the block stage is made again by each call: m = 3 gives a value, m = 0 panics in the next call of 0 frames
process 0 params n=6 m=3 frames=1 in x=[1]
process 0 params n=6 m=0 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a let of an at expression has the stage of its value: q panics in a call of 0 frames
process 0 params n=6 m=0 frames=0 in x=[]

init 0 hoist_at_stage_panics.init_through_block sr=0x41000000 cfg a=6 b0=0
